events.text: Is that... a bit of yellow? Okay...
Is that... a bit of yellow? Okay...
A waystone! I can see the waystone!
I guess that counts as yellow.
Okay, who's painting behind my back?
I can see my reflection in the marble. Wow.
If I die, put that in the report.
Waystone attuned. Progress saved. I can rest now.

profile.intro: Loot goblin. Wanders off to explore everything and won't leave a single shiny thing behind.
